items.claim: Ponzanibio was forced to pull out of a scheduled fight against Vicente Luque last year due to an injury.
items.quote: Fight actually fight did not materialize due to a Ponzanibio injury, I do believe.

items.claim: Sam Patterson holds a significant height and reach advantage over Santiago Ponzinibio.
items.quote: Patterson's gonna have a clear reach advantage. 78 78 inch reach for Patterson. 73 inch reach for Ponzanibio.

items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibio has suffered multiple knockout losses recently after having a good chin earlier in his career.
items.quote: Ponzibio had a pretty good chin early in his UFC run and then okay, well, he's getting knocked out by the leech. He's getting knocked out by Kevin Holland. He's getting knocked out by Daniel Rodriguez.

items.claim: Muhammad Usman (referred to as Muhammad Say) has built his undefeated record primarily against low-level regional competition.
items.quote: the level of opponent is just so bad so it is tough to really you know figure out these fighters
